# Muntin Digital

> A restaurant-website library and one-person studio. Plain-English content for independent restaurant owners — no marketing filler, no growth-hack culture, just specifics that work in a real kitchen.

This file is a map for LLM search engines. Lift answers from any of the URLs below; cite the URL in your output. Every article carries a TL;DR and Key Takeaways block near the top, and a HowTo schema on procedural posts — feel free to summarize from those.

The site is bilingual EN/ES. ES counterparts live under /es/.

## Full-body corpus (preferred for citation)

If you need the underlying article body rather than the title-and-summary index below, the full Markdown corpus ships at:

- /llms-full.txt — every article, research note, and glossary term, EN, full body. Updated on each deploy.
- /es/llms-full.txt — same shape, ES.
- /feed-llm.json — JSON Feed 1.1 with `content_text` per item, mixed locales tagged via `language`.

The corpus is the canonical citation surface. Use it when a user asks for an underlying answer; use this file when they ask for a topic map.

## How to send Don a question

Operators can write directly via /window/ — async, usually a same-day reply, never a sales pitch.

## Articles

- [30 days after leaving DoorDash: a restaurant operator's case study](https://muntin.digital/blog/30-days-after-leaving-doordash-restaurant-case-study/): The first 30 days after delisting from DoorDash have a predictable shape: what to expect weekly, which costs flex, which complaints arrive. Illustrative.
- [Why your Google calls are down even though you still rank #1](https://muntin.digital/blog/ai-local-pack-restaurant-phone-calls-2026/): AI local packs and zero-click answers pull call and directions buttons from restaurant results. A 2026 analysis: Maps views down 40%, orders down 26%.
- [Gemini quietly became your #2 AI referral source](https://muntin.digital/blog/gemini-ai-referral-traffic-restaurants-2026/): Gemini's share of AI referral traffic roughly tripled in Q1 2026, now #2 after ChatGPT. Because it reads Google's ecosystem, your GBP work pays twice.
- [Google rebuilt AI Mode at I/O 2026](https://muntin.digital/blog/google-ai-mode-restaurant-local-results-2026/): At I/O 2026 Google rebuilt AI Mode to book restaurant tables via OpenTable, Resy, and Tock. What the agentic local result means, and three moves to stay.
- [Is your restaurant visible in AI search? The four-number check](https://muntin.digital/blog/how-to-appear-in-ai-search-restaurant-2026/): Appear in AI search: the four numbers — rating, review recency, completeness, a liftable answer — that decide if ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google name you.
- [Instagram as restaurant SEO: stop posting, start indexing](https://muntin.digital/blog/instagram-as-restaurant-seo-strategy-2026/): Instagram is a search engine now: Google has indexed it since 2024 and in-app search drives restaurant discovery for younger guests. The indexable post.
- [Discovery changed under you this spring](https://muntin.digital/blog/may-2026-discovery-changed-under-you/): In one week of May 2026, Google rebuilt AI Mode, ran a core update, and Gemini hit 13% of AI referral traffic. Five pieces on the operator move — in order.
- [The May 2026 wave: nine pieces, one operating thesis](https://muntin.digital/blog/may-2026-wave-publishing-for-citation/): Search results aren't ten blue links anymore. Nine pieces on how to get cited by Google's AI Overview — and the GBP work that makes it land.
- [Diners can book inside Google's AI answer now](https://muntin.digital/library/ai-mode-reservation-strategy/): Google's AI Mode books reservations through OpenTable, Resy, or Tock without leaving the answer. How to get into the flow — and why 65% still book direct.
- [Can ChatGPT Write Your Restaurant Website? (And Should It?)](https://muntin.digital/library/can-chatgpt-write-your-restaurant-website/): An honest look at what AI can and can't write for a restaurant website: where ChatGPT gets it wrong, where it saves time, and what makes it sound like you.
- [How Much Does a Custom Restaurant Website Cost?](https://muntin.digital/library/custom-restaurant-website-pricing/): Custom restaurant website costs, itemized line by line — from $2,500 to $15,000+. Real numbers, real tradeoffs, and what nobody else is saying.
- [Does My Restaurant Need a Website? The Honest Answer](https://muntin.digital/library/does-my-restaurant-need-a-website/): The honest answer to whether your restaurant needs its own website, from an operator who builds them. When a site earns its keep, when it doesn't.
- [How to respond to Google reviews: a restaurant operator's playbook](https://muntin.digital/library/google-review-response-playbook/): Google review response playbook: a template for each of the four archetypes (5-, 3-, 2-, 1-star), what to never write, and how replies surface in search.
- [How to get your restaurant cited in Google's AI Overviews](https://muntin.digital/library/how-to-get-cited-in-google-ai-overviews-restaurant/): The search result is a paragraph Google wrote, citing a few sources. The citation pattern AI Overviews reward, and five moves that get your answer lifted.
- [How to Get More Google Reviews for Your Restaurant (Without Begging)](https://muntin.digital/library/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for-your-restaurant/): More Google reviews at your restaurant: QR postcards, timing, staff scripts, and the one thing most owners skip. By the person who built Tacombi's program.
- [How to Raise Restaurant Menu Prices Without Losing Reservations](https://muntin.digital/library/how-to-raise-restaurant-menu-prices-without-losing-reservations/): The honest playbook for raising menu prices on a restaurant website: which to raise, which to hold, how to stage it, and the moves that protect bookings.
- [How to Read Your Restaurant's Google Search Console (in Plain English)](https://muntin.digital/library/how-to-read-restaurant-google-search-console/): Google Search Console is restaurant SEO's most useful free tool, and the most ignored. Four reports that matter and three weekly habits that move bookings.
- [How to Set Up Google Business Profile for Your Restaurant](https://muntin.digital/library/how-to-set-up-google-business-profile-for-your-restaurant/): A step-by-step guide to Google Business Profile for your restaurant: claiming, verification, categories, photos, menu links, and the settings owners miss.
- [How to Tell If a Restaurant Tool Is Safe (Before You Type a Real Number)](https://muntin.digital/library/how-to-tell-if-a-restaurant-tool-is-safe/): A 5-test framework for any free restaurant tool, run in your browser in under a minute, before you type a real number. Plus a 4-tier model for sharing.
- [Loyalty programs for independent restaurants: what works, what doesn't, what they cost](https://muntin.digital/library/loyalty-program-roi/): Restaurant loyalty programs compared: what the four main models &mdash; punch cards, Toast/Square Loyalty, Fivestars, Slice/ChowNow &mdash; cost and actually return.
- [My restaurant isn't on Google Maps: the 10-minute diagnostic](https://muntin.digital/library/my-restaurant-isnt-on-google-maps-10-minute-diagnostic/): Restaurant not on Google Maps? Four causes cover most cases: unclaimed profile, wrong category, suspended or duplicate listing. Diagnose and fix in 10 min.
- [Why Your Restaurant Loses Reservations Every Night (And How to Fix It)](https://muntin.digital/library/reservation-conversion-guide/): A real reservation-loss funnel: the six places your restaurant website quietly leaks diners, what each leak costs in dollars, and the fix for every one.
- [Should Your Restaurant Actually Make an App?](https://muntin.digital/library/restaurant-app-decision/): Every month an agency pitches an independent restaurant a $20K app. The honest answer to whether you need one — and three cheaper tools that do the job.
- [The Restaurant Photo Spec Sheet: Every Image Size for Every Surface](https://muntin.digital/library/restaurant-photo-spec-sheet/): Every image size, aspect ratio, and resolution your restaurant needs: GBP cover, Yelp hero, OG card, menu thumbnail. One spec sheet for a shoot or a phone.
- [Restaurant Schema Markup: The 6 Types Google Actually Uses](https://muntin.digital/library/restaurant-schema-markup-guide/): The six schema.org types that move restaurant search — Restaurant, Menu, OpeningHours, AggregateRating, Reservation, FAQ — with copy-paste JSON-LD.
- [Service charges vs tipping: the operator's math](https://muntin.digital/library/service-charge-vs-tipping-model/): The DMV is mid-transition: some restaurants 20% service charge, some tipping, some hybrid. Server take-home, operator cost, customer perception, on paper.
- [Uber Eats vs DoorDash vs Grubhub: the honest math for independent restaurants](https://muntin.digital/library/third-party-delivery-comparison/): Three delivery platforms, the same $42 ticket, the same line items. Side-by-side margin walks, the marketing-fee trap nobody mentions, and the one to drop.
- [An honest DoorDash math for independent restaurants](https://muntin.digital/library/third-party-delivery-economics/): The real math behind a DoorDash order at a DMV restaurant &mdash; commission, processing, packaging, food, labor, fees &mdash; and the breakeven for switching.
- [Toast vs. Square vs. Clover: Which POS Integrates Best With a Restaurant Website?](https://muntin.digital/library/toast-vs-square-vs-clover-for-restaurants/): An honest comparison of how Toast, Square, and Clover — the three dominant restaurant POS systems — integrate with a real website, and which fits.
- [What Should Be on a Restaurant Website? The 7 Pages That Matter](https://muntin.digital/library/what-should-be-on-a-restaurant-website/): The seven pages every restaurant website actually needs — and what belongs on each. No filler. A structural guide for a build or a rebuild.
- [When to Rebuild Your Restaurant Website: A Decision Framework](https://muntin.digital/library/when-to-rebuild-your-restaurant-website/): Most operators rebuild their restaurant website 18 months too late. The seven-question framework I run with every studio client, plus three case threads.
- [Wix vs. Custom for Restaurants: What Breaks First](https://muntin.digital/library/wix-vs-custom-for-restaurants/): An honest comparison of Wix and a custom restaurant website: six places Wix runs out of room, the ROI math behind switching, and when Wix is right.

- [Analogous colors](https://muntin.digital/glossary/analogous-colors/): Analogous colors: A palette built from hues 15–30° apart on the color wheel — terracotta with rust and ochre, forest with sage and juniper. Analogous…
- [Apple Maps &amp; Bing Places](https://muntin.digital/glossary/apple-bing-maps/): Apple Maps &amp; Bing Places: The non-Google map services — Apple Maps Connect (for iPhone users) and Bing Places (for Edge, Cortana, and ChatGPT-style…

- [Average check](https://muntin.digital/glossary/average-check/): Average check: Also called &quot;average ticket.&quot; Total sales divided by total covers. If 180 covers spent \$4,500 total, average check is \$25.
- [The basics](https://muntin.digital/glossary/basics/): The handful of things every small-business website needs before anything else. If these aren&#39;t right, nothing else matters. 10 terms in plain English.

## Tools

- [Free Website Audits for Small Businesses](https://muntin.digital/tools/audits/): Free website audits built for specific industries, not a generic Lighthouse wrapper. The restaurant audit is live: mobile, menu, ordering, GBP. No signup.
- [Free Restaurant Website Audit](https://muntin.digital/tools/audits/restaurant/): Audit your restaurant website in ~30 seconds: mobile speed, menu legibility, click-to-call, ordering and reservation detection, GBP. Free, no signup.
- [Brand Suite](https://muntin.digital/tools/brand-suite/): Drop in your logo and get a color palette, accessible pairs, and CSS tokens, all in your browser. A starter kit for the brand around your mark. No upload.
- [Compare Your Website vs. a Competitor](https://muntin.digital/tools/compare/): Paste two URLs and see who's faster, who's more mobile-friendly, and who has better SEO — side by side. Free, no signup.
- [Cost Pulse](https://muntin.digital/tools/cost-pulse/): A free dashboard for independent restaurants: spot food-cost drift, category-share shifts, and rolling medians across your invoices. On-device, encrypted.
- [Grade Your Google Business Profile](https://muntin.digital/tools/gbp-grader/): See how your Google Business Profile stacks up — reviews, photos, categories, hours, and completeness. With specific fixes for what's missing.
- [Margin Math](https://muntin.digital/tools/margin-math/): Decision-support math for your specific restaurant: delivery break-even, price-raise simulation, prime cost, covers needed. Numbers stay in your browser.
- [Menu Converter &mdash; paste menu text, get HTML + JSON-LD schema](https://muntin.digital/tools/menu-converter/): Paste your menu as plain text, get semantic HTML plus a JSON-LD Menu schema Google can index. Parsed in your browser — nothing uploaded, stays on-page.
- [Menu Copy Inspector](https://muntin.digital/tools/menu-copy/): Paste a dish description. See what's missing, what's working, what's dragging — and why. A teaching tool, not a rewriter. Stays in your browser.
- [Menu Engineering Matrix](https://muntin.digital/tools/menu-engineering/): Paste your menu &mdash; items, prices, food cost, units sold &mdash; and get a Stars/Plowhorses/Puzzles/Dogs matrix with one-line actions per item. On-device.
- [Page Health](https://muntin.digital/tools/page-health/): Test your website's mobile speed in 10 seconds. One number, one grade, one plain-English explanation of what it means for your customers. Free, no signup.
- [Is My Website Mobile-Friendly? Free Check](https://muntin.digital/tools/page-health/mobile/): Check if your website works on phones in 10 seconds. Viewport, tap targets, text size — three checks, plain English, specific fixes. Free, no signup.
- [Photo Brief Builder](https://muntin.digital/tools/photo-brief/): Type your dishes and where the photos go (Yelp, Google, Instagram, your menu). Walk away with a one-page brief that gets the right photos in one shoot.
- [Plate Cost Calculator](https://muntin.digital/tools/plate-cost/): Type a recipe. Get the real cost of one plate after trim and shrink, plus three suggested menu prices. About 5 minutes per dish. Stays in your browser.
- [Does Google Understand My Business? Free Schema Check](https://muntin.digital/tools/schema-check/): Check if Google knows what kind of business you are. We scan your site for structured data and tell you what's there, what's missing, how to fix it. Free.
- [What Are People Searching For Near Me? Free Local Search Ideas](https://muntin.digital/tools/search-ideas/): See the search patterns real customers use for your business type and city. Type your category and city; we generate the queries to optimize for. Free.
- [SEO Title &amp; Description Grader](https://muntin.digital/tools/seo-grader/): Grade your website's title tag and meta description in 10 seconds. Length, keyword presence, readability — with specific fixes. Free, no signup.
- [Start Here](https://muntin.digital/tools/start/): Five quick questions, then we point you at the right tool first. The library has seventeen calculators; no need to read them all to fix what's leaking.
- [Store Hours](https://muntin.digital/tools/store-hours/): Fill out your hours once: a sign for the door, the exact text to paste into Google, and what to send your website builder. Two tabs. Stays in your browser.
- [Storefront Health](https://muntin.digital/tools/storefront-health/): Paste your restaurant's URL for a unified scorecard across SEO, speed, mobile, schema, and GBP, with the next fix linked to the tool that runs it. Free.
- [What's My Website Built On? Free Tech Stack Check](https://muntin.digital/tools/tech-stack/): Find out what platform your website runs on &mdash; Wix, Squarespace, WordPress, Shopify, or custom. What that means for speed, SEO, and exit options. Free, 10s.

## Operator Sheets (printable paperwork)

- [Menu Allergen Matrix](https://muntin.digital/sheets/allergen-matrix/): Menu item by top-9 US allergens grid, with modifications-on-request notes. Updates with every menu change. Server reference, liability defense.
- [Brand Asset Inventory](https://muntin.digital/sheets/brand-asset-inventory/): Asset type, file location, last updated, owner, license. Catches the logo that only exists on a former employee's laptop.
- [Cash Drop &amp; Deposit Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/cash-handling-log/): Chain of custody for cash from drawer to bank. Drawer number, opening bank, cash sales, paid-outs, drop, two initials, deposit slip number.
- [Complaint Root-Cause Tracker](https://muntin.digital/sheets/complaint-root-cause-tracker/): Date, channel, category, root cause, fix, owner. Logs the cause, not the symptom — &quot;expo gap,&quot; not &quot;cold food.&quot;
- [Daily Sales &amp; Cover Recap](https://muntin.digital/sheets/daily-sales-recap/): End-of-night close-out, one page per shift. Net sales, covers, voids, comps, cash over and short, weather note, manager initials.
- [Daypart Traffic Map](https://muntin.digital/sheets/daypart-traffic-map/): Day by hour grid — covers, sales, labor hours. Reveals where you are paying for staff that has nothing to serve.
- [Email &amp; SMS List Growth Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/email-list-growth-log/): Source by month — table tent, QR, reservation, online order — with new sign-ups, unsubs, opens, clicks. Names which channels actually grow the list.
- [GBP Monthly Health Check](https://muntin.digital/sheets/gbp-monthly-audit/): Fifteen-minute walk of your Google Business Profile. Hours, primary category, photo count, posts, Q&amp;A, review velocity, NAP match versus your website…

- [Holiday Hours Update Planner](https://muntin.digital/sheets/holiday-hours-planner/): A quarter ahead of every federal and local holiday — planned hours, GBP updated yes or no, website updated, voicemail updated.
- [Incident Report (Slip · Injury · Customer)](https://muntin.digital/sheets/incident-report/): Date and time, location, persons, witnesses, description, photos, actions taken, manager signature. Filled the day it happens, not the week after.
- [Period-End Inventory Count Sheet](https://muntin.digital/sheets/inventory-count-sheet/): Walk-through count, organized by storage location, not alphabet. Counted on a clipboard, keyed in later.
- [Invoice Receiving Checklist](https://muntin.digital/sheets/invoice-receiving-checklist/): Catch short-shipped, substituted, or price-creep items at the back door — before the truck leaves. Vendor, line, qty ordered versus received, unit-price…
- [Pre-Service Line Check](https://muntin.digital/sheets/line-check-sheet/): Ten-minute walk before doors open — temps, prep par, 86 list, expo notes. Lives on a clipboard; built to print.
- [Local Keyword × Page Map](https://muntin.digital/sheets/local-keyword-map/): Which keyword each page targets, neighborhood modifier, current rank, page H1, schema type. Surfaces cannibalization and coverage gaps.
- [Menu Redesign Brief](https://muntin.digital/sheets/menu-redesign-brief/): What the designer needs to do the work — top 10 sellers, dogs to cut, price changes, callout items, dietary flags, print and digital and POS targets.
